variants.description: Current structured instruction with one full definition per label.
Shorter wording with the same eight labels, concise definitions, multi-label rule, and JSON-only output contract.

controls.checkpoint: same exact local Qwen checkpoint for every run

selection.primary: highest mean micro_f1 across English and Turkish DEV
selection.tie_break_1: highest mean sample_jaccard across English and Turkish DEV
selection.tie_break_2: lowest mean malformed_output_rate across English and Turkish DEV
selection.tie_break_3: lexicographically smallest variant id for an exact numerical tie

test_policy: TEST is prohibited during comparison. The selected variant must be recorded and frozen before any TEST run.
